verdict.rationale: Kintsugi exposes a broad REST API and five SDKs covering core workflows—transaction sync, nexus, registrations, filings, exemptions, tax estimation, refunds/credit notes—suggesting most UI functionality (data sources, filings, exemptions, registrations) is API-accessible. However there's no explicit statement that 100% of UI actions are API-parity, and the OpenAPI spec is not publicly resolvable (404s across candidate paths), making it hard to verify full coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a working public OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation that all UI-only features (e.g. connector setup wizards) have API equivalents.
